<h1 class="entry-title" itemprop="headline">“The Hope For Healing” Scholarship</h1>
<div  class="site-inner"><div  class="content-sidebar-wrap"><main class="content" id="genesis-content"><article class="post-82562 page type-page status-publish has-post-thumbnail entry" aria-label="“The Hope For Healing” Scholarship" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork"><div class="entry-content" itemprop="text"><p style="text-align: center;"><strong><em>Congratulations to our <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/26-winners">2026 Winners</a>!<br />
and a special recognition to our <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/26-finalists">2026 Finalists</a>!</em></strong></p>
<div class="su-divider su-divider-style-default" style="margin:15px 0;border-width:2px;border-color:#246cb3"></div>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]"><strong>Hope for Healing Scholarship: (2) $5,000 Awards – </strong><strong>Next Deadline: February 7, 2027<br />
</strong></p>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Two $5,000 scholarships awarded annually, one undergraduate, one graduate, to students pursuing a degree in mental/behavioral health, nursing, or addiction medicine. Open to currently enrolled students (or those with proof of acceptance) with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.</p>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">The Hope for Healing Scholarship has been awarded annually since 2020 and accepts applications on a continuous, rolling basis throughout the year. The current selection period closes February 7, 2027.</p>
<div class="su-divider su-divider-style-default" style="margin:15px 0;border-width:2px;border-color:#246cb3"></div>
<div class="su-button-center"><a href="#jumptoform" class="su-button su-button-style-flat su-button-wide" style="color:#FFFFFF;background-color:#0356a1;border-color:#034581;border-radius:5px" target="_self"><span style="color:#FFFFFF;padding:7px 20px;font-size:16px;line-height:24px;border-color:#4f89be;border-radius:5px;text-shadow:none"><i class="sui sui-edit" style="font-size:16px;color:#FFFFFF"></i> Apply for Scholarship Now</span></a></div>
<h2>The “Hope for Healing Scholarship”</h2>
<div >The Hope for Healing Scholarship is an evergreen offering that awards two recipients annually. The purpose of the scholarship, awarded to one undergraduate and one graduate student each year, is to encourage more of America’s best and brightest to pursue a vocation in the field of <a href="https://fherehab.com/drug-addiction/">addiction</a> and <a href="https://fherehab.com/mental-health-rehab/">mental health treatment</a>. Applications are now being accepted on a continuous, rolling basis for FHE Health’s “Hope for Healing Scholarships.” The current selection period closes <strong>February 7, 2027</strong>.</div>
<div></div>
<div><strong>Meet Previous Winners:</strong></div>
<ul>
<li><strong><a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/26-finalists">2026</a>: Congratulations <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/26-undergraduate">Joshua Jones</a> and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/26-graduate">Elena Dos Santo</a>s!</strong></li>
<li><a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/25-winners">2025</a>: <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/25-graduate">Kim Koger</a> (Graduate) and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/25-undergraduate">Catalina Artuz</a> (Undergraduate)</li>
<li><a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/24-winners">2024</a>: <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/2024-graduate">Dona Nguyen</a> (Graduate) and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/2024-undergraduate">Joseph Swaress</a> (Undergaduate)</li>
<li><a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/2023-winners">2023</a>: <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/23-graduate">Lindsay Koncz</a> (Graduate) and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/23-undergraduate">Mason Collie</a> (Undergraduate)</li>
<li>2022: <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/22-graduate">Amy Burrell</a> (Graduate) and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/22-undergraduate">Jack Mattingly</a> (Undergraduate)</li>
<li>2021: <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/21-graduate">Amad Amedy</a> (Graduate) and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/21-undergraduate">Tamera Miller</a> (Undergraduate)</li>
<li>2020: <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/20-graduate">Melanie Ryerson</a> (Graduate) and <a href="https://fherehab.com/scholarship/20-undergraduate">Isabela Buckingham</a> (Undergraduate)</li>
</ul>
<h3><b>Who Can Apply?</b></h3>
<ul>
<li><b>Any undergraduate and graduate students</b> currently enrolled in a degree program in mental/behavioral health, nursing, or addiction medicine</li>
<li><b>We welcome <a href="https://fherehab.com/services/first-responders/">veterans</a></b>, <b>minorities</b>, and <b>people with disabilities</b>, who are currently enrolled in a graduate or undergraduate degree program in mental/behavioral, nursing, or addiction medicine. (This is not a requirement for applying)</li>
</ul>
<p><iframe data-placeholder-image="https://fherehab.com/wp-content/uploads/complianz/placeholders/youtube8esvV2zx8xY-hqdefault.webp" data-category="marketing" data-service="youtube" class="cmplz-placeholder-element cmplz-iframe cmplz-iframe-styles cmplz-video " data-cmplz-target="src" data-src-cmplz="https://www.youtube.com/embed/8esvV2zx8xY"  src="about:blank"  width="800" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen" data-mce-fragment="1"><span data-mce-type="bookmark" style="display: inline-block; width: 0px; overflow: hidden; line-height: 0;" class="mce_SELRES_start">﻿</span><span data-mce-type="bookmark" style="display: inline-block; width: 0px; overflow: hidden; line-height: 0;" class="mce_SELRES_start">﻿</span><span data-mce-type="bookmark" style="display: inline-block; width: 0px; overflow: hidden; line-height: 0;" class="mce_SELRES_start">﻿</span></iframe></p>
<h3>Deadline for Applications and Timeline for Award</h3>
<p>FHE Health is currently accepting applications for two Hope for Healing scholarships:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>A $5,000 scholarship to one qualified, college-level applicant</strong> enrolled in an undergraduate program of study</li>
<li><strong>A $5,000 scholarship to one qualified, graduate-level applicant</strong> enrolled in a Masters or Doctorate program of study</li>
</ul>
<p>This is a continuously running scholarship, the next group of winners will be announced on <strong>March 1st, 2027.</strong></p>
<p>Scholarship award money will be paid directly to the school in which the student will be enrolled on May 1st 2027.</p>
<div class="su-accordion su-u-trim"><div class="su-spoiler su-spoiler-style-default su-spoiler-icon-plus su-spoiler-closed" data-scroll-offset="0" data-anchor-in-url="no"><div class="su-spoiler-title" tabindex="0" role="button"><span class="su-spoiler-icon"></span>Scholarship Requirements</div><div class="su-spoiler-content su-u-clearfix su-u-trim">
<h3>Undergraduate</h3>
<ul>
<li>Undergraduate Scholarship applicants must be currently enrolled in a four-year degree program or show proof of acceptance to an institution that offers four-year degrees.</li>
<li>Must have a GPA of 3.0 or higher in the last completed academic year at a four-year institution, a GPA of 3.0 or higher in the most recent quarter or semester, or if no college has been completed a 3.5 high school GPA.</li>
<li>Academic focus in the area of mental and behavioral health or psychiatric nursing as demonstrated by a major or minor course of study</li>
</ul>
<h3>Graduate</h3>
<ul>
<li>Graduate Scholarship applicants must be currently enrolled in a graduate degree program or show proof of acceptance to an institution that offers Masters and Doctorate degrees.</li>
<li>Must have graduated from an accredited four-year institution with a GPA of 3.0 or higher</li>
<li>Academic focus in an area of study related to mental and behavioral health, nursing or addiction medicine</li>
</ul>
</div></div> </div>
<div class="su-accordion su-u-trim"><div class="su-spoiler su-spoiler-style-default su-spoiler-icon-plus su-spoiler-closed" data-scroll-offset="0" data-anchor-in-url="no"><div class="su-spoiler-title" tabindex="0" role="button"><span class="su-spoiler-icon"></span>Application Requirements</div><div class="su-spoiler-content su-u-clearfix su-u-trim">
<h3>Application Requirements</h3>
<p>All applicants are required to complete a form on this website page. From those applicants, finalists will be selected.</p>
<p>All applicants will be required to submit the following materials:</p>
<ul>
<li>High school or college transcripts</li>
<li>Proof of current college enrollment or acceptance</li>
<li>Documentation of course of study</li>
<li>A typed essay that describes why you are pursuing study in mental and behavioral health, nursing or addiction medicine, and what you want to contribute to the field</li>
<li>A completed application form</li>
</ul>
</div></div> </div>
<div class="su-accordion su-u-trim"><div class="su-spoiler su-spoiler-style-default su-spoiler-icon-plus su-spoiler-closed" data-scroll-offset="0" data-anchor-in-url="no"><div class="su-spoiler-title" tabindex="0" role="button"><span class="su-spoiler-icon"></span>The Selection Process</div><div class="su-spoiler-content su-u-clearfix su-u-trim">
<h3>The Selection Process</h3>
<p>200 qualified applications (100 undergrad 100 grad) will be chosen for review by drawing. Our Scholarship board will review the 200 selected applications for:</p>
<ul>
<li>academic performance</li>
<li>quality of essay</li>
<li>and the applicant’s potential for positive impact on the field of mental and behavioral health (as demonstrated by the essay and level of current volunteer activities or employment in the field)</li>
</ul>
<p>Decisions of the Scholarship board are final.</p>
</div></div> </div>
<div class="su-accordion su-u-trim"><div class="su-spoiler su-spoiler-style-default su-spoiler-icon-plus su-spoiler-closed" data-scroll-offset="0" data-anchor-in-url="no"><div class="su-spoiler-title" tabindex="0" role="button"><span class="su-spoiler-icon"></span>Non-Discrimination Policy Disclaimer</div><div class="su-spoiler-content su-u-clearfix su-u-trim">
<h3 id="jumptoform">Non-Discrimination Policy Disclaimer</h3>
<p>FHE Health does not discriminate on any basis, whether by age, race, sex, religion, disability status or sexual orientation. All qualified applicants are given equal consideration and are assessed strictly based on the strength of their application and essay. It is at the sole discretion of our team to select the applicant we feel was most persuasive about why they are pursuing a vocational call to work in the field of addiction and mental health treatment. By applying for the Hope for Healing Scholarship, you agree to <a href="https://fherehab.com/about-us/">FHE Health’s</a> privacy policy and disclaimer.</p>
</div></div> </div>
